description:
Simple. Fast. Built to disappear beneath you and let the ride take over. The Rambler V2 helped define Wondercross, and these are the final frames of its generation.
Large is the only remaining size. The Legacy Package is $2,199 AUD, reduced from $4,699.

This is a frameset package. Wheels, groupset, cockpit, saddle and the other components needed to complete your bike are sold separately.
Built for the long way home
Long road days, rough back roads and light gravel. The Rambler V2 blends comfort, durability and speed in a timeless titanium platform, ready for you to make it your own.
Paired with our upgraded Wondercross Titanium Fork, the Legacy Package gives you a full titanium foundation for your next build.
The final chapter of V2
As we continue developing the Rambler platform, we've uncovered the last remaining V2 frames. With Ramblers finding homes across Australia and beyond, we're offering these final frames as the Legacy Package.
Once these are gone, they're gone.
Find your fit
Large is the only size available to purchase. If you're unsure about sizing, get in touch with WXSHOP with your height, inseam and current bike model and size. We'll help you check the fit and talk through your build.
